data.title: Ensure compliance with ADR requirements for consignments of dangerous goods.
data.description:
Ensure compliance with ADR requirements for consignments of dangerous goods.

- Ascertain that dangerous goods are classified and authorized for carriage according to ADR.
- Provide the carrier with necessary information, data, and transport documents in a traceable form.
- Use approved and suitable packagings, large packagings, IBCs, and tanks marked as per ADR.
- Adhere to dispatch and forwarding restrictions.
- Ensure empty uncleaned tanks and vehicles are placarded, marked, labelled, closed, and leakproof as if full.
- For tank-containers and portable tanks with refrigerated liquefied gases, determine the actual holding time or reduce pressure for empty, uncleaned tanks.

data.title: Develop a written plan for employee participation in process safety management.
data.description:
Develop a written plan for employee participation in process safety management.

- Develop a written plan of action for implementing employee participation.
- Consult with employees and their representatives on process hazards analyses and other elements of process safety management.
- Provide employees and their representatives access to process hazard analyses and all other required information.

data.title: Complete a compilation of written process safety information before conducting any process hazard analysis.
data.description:
Complete a compilation of written process safety information before conducting any process hazard analysis.

- Compile written process safety information to identify and understand hazards of processes involving highly hazardous chemicals.
- Include information on the hazards of the chemicals, such as toxicity, permissible exposure limits, physical data, reactivity, corrosivity, stability, and hazardous effects of mixing materials.
- Include information on the technology of the process, such as flow diagrams, process chemistry, inventory limits, safe operating limits, and consequences of deviations.
- Include information on the equipment, such as materials of construction, piping and instrument diagrams, electrical classification, relief and ventilation system design, design codes, material and energy balances, and safety systems.
- Document compliance with recognized engineering practices and ensure safe operation of equipment designed to outdated standards.

data.title: Perform an initial process hazard analysis and update it every five years.
data.description:
Perform an initial process hazard analysis and update it every five years.

- Conduct an initial process hazard analysis for each process, considering its complexity and potential hazards.
- Use appropriate methodologies such as What-If, Checklist, HAZOP, FMEA, Fault Tree Analysis, or equivalent.
- Ensure the analysis addresses process hazards, previous incidents, controls, facility siting, human factors, and potential safety and health effects.
- Form a team with expertise in engineering and process operations, including at least one employee with specific process knowledge and one knowledgeable in the analysis methodology.
- Establish a system to address and document the team's findings and recommendations, and communicate actions to affected employees.
- Retain all analyses and documented resolutions for the life of the process.

data.title: Develop and implement written operating procedures for each covered process.
data.description:
Develop and implement written operating procedures for each covered process.

- Develop and implement written operating procedures with clear instructions for safely conducting activities in each covered process.
- Include steps for each operating phase: initial startup, normal operations, temporary operations, emergency shutdown, emergency operations, normal shutdown, and startup after a turnaround or emergency shutdown.
- Define operating limits, including consequences of deviation and corrective steps.
- Address safety and health considerations, including chemical hazards, exposure prevention, control measures, quality control for raw materials, and unique hazards.
- Ensure safety systems and their functions are included.
- Make operating procedures readily accessible to employees involved in or maintaining a process.
- Review and update operating procedures as necessary to reflect current practices and certify annually that they are current and accurate.
- Develop and implement safe work practices for hazard control during operations, applicable to both employees and contractor employees.

data.title: Train employees involved in operating a process and document the training.
data.description:
Train employees involved in operating a process and document the training.

- Train each employee currently involved in operating a process and each employee before starting a new process on the process overview and operating procedures.
- Emphasize specific safety and health hazards, emergency operations, and safe work practices during training.
- Certify in writing the knowledge, skills, and abilities of employees already involved in a process as of May 26, 1992, if initial training is not provided.
- Provide refresher training at least every three years or more frequently if necessary, in consultation with employees.
- Document that each employee has received and understood the training, including the employee's identity, training date, and verification method.

data.title: Perform a pre-startup safety review for new and significantly modified facilities.
data.description:
Perform a pre-startup safety review for new and significantly modified facilities.

- Effectuez une revue de sécurité avant le démarrage pour les nouvelles installations et les installations modifiées de manière significative.
- Confirmez que la construction et l'équipement sont conformes aux spécifications de conception avant l'introduction de produits chimiques hautement dangereux.
- Assurez-vous que les procédures de sécurité, d'exploitation, de maintenance et d'urgence sont en place et adéquates.
- Réalisez une analyse des risques de procédé pour les nouvelles installations et résolvez ou mettez en œuvre les recommandations avant le démarrage.
- Vérifiez que les installations modifiées répondent aux exigences de gestion du changement.
- Complétez la formation de chaque employé impliqué dans l'exploitation d'un procédé.

data.title: Establish and implement written procedures to maintain the ongoing integrity of process equipment.
data.description:
Establish and implement written procedures to maintain the ongoing integrity of process equipment.

- Establish and implement written procedures to maintain the ongoing integrity of process equipment.
- Train employees involved in maintenance on process overview, hazards, and job-specific procedures to ensure safe task performance.
- Perform inspections and tests on process equipment following recognized good engineering practices and document each inspection and test.
- Correct equipment deficiencies outside acceptable limits before further use or in a safe and timely manner.
- Ensure new equipment is suitable for its intended process application and perform checks to confirm proper installation.
- Ensure maintenance materials, spare parts, and equipment are suitable for their intended process application.

data.title: Establish and implement written procedures to manage changes to process chemicals, technology, equipment, procedures, and facilities affecting a covered process.
data.description:
Establish and implement written procedures to manage changes to process chemicals, technology, equipment, procedures, and facilities affecting a covered process.

- Establish and implement written procedures for managing changes to process chemicals, technology, equipment, procedures, and facilities.
- Ensure the procedures address the technical basis, safety and health impact, modifications to operating procedures, necessary time period, and authorization requirements before any change.
- Inform and train employees involved in operating, maintenance, and contract employees affected by the change before process start-up.
- Update process safety information if changes affect it.
- Update operating procedures or practices if changes affect them.

Ensure compliance with ADR requirements for consignments of dangerous goods.

- Ascertain that dangerous goods are classified and authorized for carriage according to ADR.
- Provide the carrier with necessary information, data, and transport documents in a traceable form.
- Use approved and suitable packagings, large packagings, IBCs, and tanks marked as per ADR.
- Adhere to dispatch and forwarding restrictions.
- Ensure empty uncleaned tanks and vehicles are placarded, marked, labelled, closed, and leakproof as if full.
- For tank-containers and portable tanks with refrigerated liquefied gases, determine the actual holding time or reduce pressure for empty, uncleaned tanks.
